news.title: US Market: SEC unveils five-year exemption for tokenized stock trading

news.title: SEC gives tokenized stock trading platforms five-year regulatory relief
news.description: The US SEC has granted a five-year exemption to platforms offering tokenized stocks, easing regulatory hurdles for blockchain-based share trading. The move could bring crypto platforms deeper into traditional equity markets, allowing potential 24/7 trading, instant settlement and fractional ownership, while maintaining issuer consent and investor protection requirements.

news.title: TOP Financial Group Limited Announces Strategic Relocation of Global Headquarters to the United States
news.description: HOUSTON, Texas, Sept. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- TOP Financial Group Limited (NASDAQ: TOP, 'TOP” or the 'Company”), a fast-growing online brokerage firm specializing in local and foreign equities, futures, and options products, today announced the strategic relocation of its global headquarters to the United States. This transition marks a pivotal milestone in the company’s long-term growth strategy, as it gradually shifts its primary corporate focus and operational footprint to the American market. The new headquarters address is: 4201 Main Street, Suite 200, Houston, Texas 77002.

news.title: PPFAS GIFT reduces minimum investment in its two outbound passive funds to $500
news.description: PPFAS GIFT has cut the minimum investment in its S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 outbound passive funds from $5,000 to $500, effective August 25. The move aims to broaden access to global diversification for eligible Indian investors through GIFT City, offering index-linked exposure to leading US companies without requiring foreign brokerage accounts.
